d:
Hazen Audel braves Australia’s scorching Outback in search of a hidden freshwater oasis. With deadly creatures, extreme heat, and scarce water, he draws on Aboriginal survival wisdom to navigate the unforgiving wilderness.
Survival expert Hazen Audel takes on the planet’s toughest environments, from dense jungles to frozen wildernesses, using traditional survival skills, courage and instinct to overcome nature’s most extreme challenges.
